notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only the Forest Fire Lookout Association county table names this tower; the statewide context is from WJFW. Two searches found no build, staffing, removal or site-today source. Do not confuse with 'Virgin Lake' in the Nicolet National Forest history (npshistory.com chap2, chap3, chap4): there it is a ranger station, a fire-trail start on Highway 32 and a CCC camp (F-1, Argonne district), a different place, not used. The 119-tower count from WJFW conflicts with a 138 count in a Wisconsin Historical Society post seen only as a search snippet (page would not load), so it was not used. The DNR lake page for Virgin Lake returned no usable text. Story runs about 110 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because no source gives more.
